label: Every nonblocking target is a register
section: Every nonblocking target is a register
subgoals: Find every variable assigned with nonblocking assignment in a clocked block
Keep conditionally assigned registers as flip-flops with enable
Sum the widths of the inferred registers

label: Blocking temporaries written before read
subgoals: Check whether each temporary is written before any read in the block
Treat a written-before-read temporary as combinational logic
Exclude it from the flip-flop count

label: Temporaries read before written
subgoals: Find reads that occur before the variable's write in the block
Recognize that such a read observes last cycle's value
Add a flip-flop for every variable live on entry to the block
